question: What power does an appeal to truth grant for removing the sin of brahmin-killing?
premises: A solemn truth is invoked as an effective instrument.
The goddess is addressed as the agent of removal.
The sin of brahmin-killing is named as the object to be removed.
inference: By the force of invoked truth, the goddess is petitioned to remove the grave sin of brahmin-killing.
uncertainties: The specific prior truth referred to by tena is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: O goddess, by that truth of mine, may you remove the sin of brahmin-killing.
